name: Zeleno-levi front (ZLF)
detail: Programme (2023) proposes reform of the property tax (include foreign real estate, exempt the family home), a tax on cars, boats and aircraft by value, a stronger inheritance tax and tax on unexplained wealth; no recurring tax on net wealth. The programme text mentions a "porez na neto svetsku imovinu" only as a comparison for the vehicle and vessel tax base.

name: Zeleno-levi poslanicki klub (windfall tax on war profiteers)
detail: Parliamentary group proposal of a 39% crisis tax on extra profits of companies: a windfall profit tax, not a wealth tax.

name: Vladimir Simovic (Centar za politike emancipacije)
detail: Argues for progressive income tax and notes the lack of an inheritance tax; no wealth tax.

name: Goran Radosavljevic, Fiskalni savet models of progressive income tax
detail: Fiscal Council and economists quoted in 021.rs and Nezavisnost propose higher marginal income tax rates, not wealth taxation.

name: Dusan Pavlovic (Danas column on Saez and Zucman)
detail: Column of 20 March 2021 presents the wealth tax proposed by Saez and Zucman and calls low taxation of Buffett unfair, but is a book recommendation that does not itself call for a Serbian wealth tax.
